summary: Implemented a softer co-located flashlight profile across live, teleop, and orbit render paths. The workflow now defaults to a broad floodlight shape instead of the narrow hard-circle cone, while keeping fixed exposure, scene-light scaling, direction controls, spawn_flashlight=false diagnostics, and no-indirect-bounce behavior intact.
work_completed: Changed live and orbit flashlight defaults to inner cone 2.0 degrees, outer cone 60.0 degrees, source radius 12.0, and soft source radius 80.0.
Added --source-radius and --soft-source-radius arguments to examples/flashlight/run.py and examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py with finite non-negative validation.
Added best-effort USpotLightComponent shape setters using SetSourceRadius/SetSoftSourceRadius first, then property/editor-property fallbacks when methods are unavailable.
Applied the light-shape controls in run.py live mode and run_orbit_collection.py teleop/render spawn_flashlight paths.

Updated examples/flashlight/run_orbit_workflow.sh defaults to intensity 1200, attenuation radius 650, inner cone 2, outer cone 60, source radius 12, and soft source radius 80, with matching CLI and environment overrides.
Updated examples/flashlight/orbit_light_settings.json active flashlight intensities to 1200.0 for scene_off_flashlight_on and scene_on_flashlight_on.
Updated docs/running_our_example_applications.md to document the softer floodlight validation profile and new environment overrides.
Added/updated focused tests for parser defaults, invalid shape arguments, workflow defaults, checked-in light settings, and spotlight shape setter fallbacks.
